newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Stray mortar kills Somali child at orphanage.
newsitem.headline: Stray mortar kills Somali child at orphanage.

text.p: A nine-year-old boy was killed in the Somali capital on Tuesday when a stray mortar round landed in the lunch hall of an orphanage during fighting between militiamen.
The mortar was fired during an exchange between forces of faction leaders Hussein Aideed and Hassan Osman Ali Atto in the south of the capital.
Farhio Subow, nine, was one of 160 children at an orphanage run by Saudi Arabian non-governmental organisation Al-Haramayn.
Somalia has had no central government since the overthrow of late dicatator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
